title: Cybersecurity and Networking Support
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

outcomes: Students will be able to implement and manage secure network environments by configuring, monitoring, and troubleshooting endpoint security, network defense technologies, firewalls, intrusion prevention systems, and other protective controls to prevent and mitigate cybersecurity threats.

Students will be able to analyze cybersecurity risks and apply industry-aligned strategies to protect organizational assets across on-premises and cloud environments, demonstrating the technical, documentation, and foundational management skills needed for entry-level roles in cybersecurity or networking support.

Students will be able to demonstrate proficiency with industry-standard tools and practices by applying knowledge and hands-on skills aligned with professional certifications such as Cisco CCNA, CompTIA Security+, EC-Council CEH, and Cisco CyberOps, and by supporting secure installation, configuration, and maintenance of hardware and software systems.
